title: Bug: t0 tests fail to start due to error about dash
author: cpackham-atlnz
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

Hi,

I'm trying to run the tests from the 202511 branch. When I run the t0 tests (`-t t0,any`)

The pretest runs (and passes) but then the actual test fails to start with an error

```
15:59:29  ==================================== ERRORS ====================================
15:59:29  ________ ERROR collecting tests/dash/test_dash_privatelink_redirect.py _________
15:59:29  ImportError while importing test module '/data/sonic-mgmt-test/tests/dash/test_dash_privatelink_redirect.py'.
15:59:29  Hint: make sure your test modules/packages have valid Python names.
15:59:29  Traceback:
15:59:29  /usr/lib/python3.12/importlib/__init__.py:90: in import_module
15:59:29      return _bootstrap._gcd_import(name[level:], package, level)
15:59:29             ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
15:59:29  dash/test_dash_privatelink_redirect.py:17: in <module>
15:59:29      from conftest import get_interface_ip
15:59:29  E   ImportError: cannot import name 'get_interface_ip' from 'conftest' (/data/sonic-mgmt-test/tests/wol/conftest.py)
```

I'm guessing somehow picking up conftest.py from tests/wol is the problem but no idea how it's getting that one and not the one from tests/dash

### Steps to Reproduce

`./run_tests.sh -t t0,any -f ../ansible/testbed.yaml -i ../ansible/lab`

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Tests run

comments.author: theasianpianist
comments.body:
> [@theasianpianist](https://github.com/theasianpianist) for viz. Can you check how t0 tests passed?

Our nightly tests run in 'individual' mode, which is equivalent to manually running each test module one at a time. So running the PL redirect test means `dash/conftest.py` is the most recently loaded conftest file when the test imports are resolved.

`run_tests.sh` however uses 'group' mode by default, which lumps all test cases together in a single session. When the DASH test imports are resolved, if a different conftest file was the most recently loaded then we can hit this issue.

linkedPullRequests.title: [DASH] Use specific import
linkedPullRequests.author: cpackham-atlnz
linkedPullRequests.body:
Update test_dash_privatelink_redirect.py to import the correct conftest to use.

### Description of PR

The tests were failing to start because test_dash_privatelink_redirect.py was picking up the wrong conftest.py. It probably depended on what conftest was found when python traversed the various imports so it may have been picking up the right one in some cases.
